fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard is enclosed by an ornamental black metal perimeter fence along the Shepherd Ave frontage (clearly visible in June-2025 Street View, with PFG-branded tractors lined up behind it). However the fence has wide OPEN driveway gaps with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or staffed checkpoint — no controlled gate in any view. Fenced yard with open driveway entrances = truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any driveway opening — none seen along the full Shepherd Ave frontage in Street View or in z19-z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — no gate, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveway openings in the perimeter fence — one serving the south drop yard, one serving the north dock-yard area — give distinct in/out points; truckGateCount=2.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved holding area north of the main building and broad internal yard provide ample truck queuing room inside the fence before the docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ — extensive trailer storage: angled trailer rows in the south drop yard plus a long line of tractors/trailers along the Shepherd Ave fence. PFG-branded trailers confirmed in Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the east face of the main building with many trailers backed in; ~35 doors estimated — flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Lockland / Reading industrial corridor north of Cincinnati, wedged between I-75 and an active rail line, with residential immediately east — clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs immediately east of the property but no spur enters the PFG site itself.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC building plus a separate long narrow building at the south end of the property.
